properties.name: supportingText
properties.description: Secondary descriptive text below the headline.

properties.name: selected
properties.description: Whether the item is currently selected.

properties.name: indeterminate
properties.description:
Mixed/partial state for a `checkbox` item — renders a dash in the check
slot instead of a tick and exposes `aria-checked="mixed"`. Used for a
"select all" affordance where only some children are selected. Ignored for
`button`/`radio` types and when `selected` is true.

properties.name: keepOpen
properties.description: Prevent the parent menu from closing when this item is clicked.

properties.name: divider
properties.description: Render a divider line below this item.

properties.name: gap
properties.description: Render a gap (extra space) below this item — an alternative separator to divider.

properties.name: badge
properties.description: Small badge label (e.g. "New") displayed before the trailing area.

properties.name: type
properties.description: Type of item: 'button' (default action), 'checkbox' (toggle), or 'radio' (single-select within group).

properties.name: checkPosition
properties.description: Position of the selection checkmark indicator.

properties.name: presentation
properties.description:
ARIA presentation. `'menuitem'` (default) exposes the item with the menu
role family (`menuitem` / `menuitemradio` / `menuitemcheckbox`, state via
`aria-checked`). `'option'` exposes it as a listbox option (`role="option"`,
state via `aria-selected`) — used by `md-select` so the popup is a proper
WAI-ARIA combobox/listbox rather than a menu.

properties.name: roleOverride
properties.description:
Override the computed ARIA role. Used when a checkbox/radio item is NOT inside
a menu — e.g. a "select all" toggle in a listbox popup, which is semantically a
`checkbox` (keeps `aria-checked`, drops the menu-only required-parent). Empty =
the default menuitem/option role family.

properties.name: density
properties.description:
Local density rung. Drives the same `--md-sys-density-scale` signal that a
global `data-density` ancestor sets, so a local value simply overrides the
inherited one. 0 = default, -4 = ultra-compact.

name: Menu Item
description: One row in a md-menu. A command, or a checkbox/radio option, with optional icons, supporting text, a badge and trailing text.

notes: Rendered by its md-menu: one- and two-line rows with the leading-icon and trailing-icon slots, trailing text, badge, divider and gap, checkbox and radio rows (check position, indeterminate, keep-open), option presentation and role override, density; hover, press and keyboard focus show the state layer, the md-ripple wave and the inset 3-point focus ring.

Activation emits mdClick and closes the menu tree after 150 ms unless keep-open; Space toggles checkbox and radio rows without closing; disabled rows stay focusable in the roving order (APG) but inert.
